glosses: to leave someone high and dry, to hang out to dry, to let someone down

examples.text: Ich hätte jetzt dringend ihre Hilfe gebraucht, aber sie hat mich einfach hängenlassen.
examples.translation: I would have needed her help now urgently, but she simply left me high and dry.
examples.english: I would have needed her help now urgently, but she simply left me high and dry.

glosses: to loosen up, to lose control or self-discipline
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see hängen, lassen.
